title: Overthinking is the Only Wall
style: 100 BPM mid-tempo electro-pop, warm male lead with NZ AU lean, layered backing harmonies, pulsing synth bass, soft four-on-the-floor kick, hand percussion, glassy synth pads, sparkling pre-chorus arpeggios, anthemic chorus with handclaps and group vocals, contemplative bridge, hopeful and clear, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — pulsing synth, soft kick]
Overthinking… overthinking…
That's the only wall
Overthinking… overthinking…
That's the only wall at all

[Verse 1]
Stood at the door for a hundred years
Rehearsed every line, ran through every fear
The room was open, the light was on
By the time I moved, the moment was gone

Not the people, not the place
Not the weather, not the space
Just the loop running in my head
Saying every word that I never said

[Pre-Chorus]
Dad said the rest of them are only humans
They're practicing too, they're guessing too
Focus on you and what you're naturally good at
That's the whole secret — the wall comes through

[Chorus]
Overthinking is the only wall
Overthinking is the only wall
Name it, face it, watch it fall
Overthinking is the only wall at all
Say hi, take the step, make the call
Overthinking is the only wall

[Verse 2]
The brain wants a plan for a simple thing
A seven-step map for a hello, a wing
But the body knows, the heart knows too
The move is small, the move is true

Drop the script, drop the dress rehearsal
Life's not a play, it's not universal
It's a Tuesday, it's a hand, it's a name
It's not a contest — it's not a game

[Pre-Chorus]
Dad said the rest of them are only humans
They're practicing too, they're guessing too
Focus on you and what you're naturally good at
That's the whole secret — the wall comes through

[Chorus]
Overthinking is the only wall
Overthinking is the only wall
Name it, face it, watch it fall
Overthinking is the only wall at all
Say hi, take the step, make the call
Overthinking is the only wall

[Bridge — stripped, spoken-sung]
The wall isn't out there.
The wall isn't them.
The wall is the loop.
Name the loop, the loop ends.
MOSOKO — simple lands.

[Final Chorus — full lift]
Overthinking is the only wall
Overthinking is the only wall
Name it, face it, watch it fall
Overthinking is the only wall at all
Say hi, take the step, make the call
Overthinking — the only wall

[Outro]
The hard part's done…
The hard part's done…
See you on Tuesday
